privacy.heading: Privacy Policy.
privacy.lead: Plain language about what this website collects and why. Last reviewed at launch.

sections.title: Who we are
body: Savo Technologies, operating as Savo Technologies Private Limited, maintains this website. Questions about this policy or your data can be sent to hello@savotechnologies.com.

sections.title: Information we collect
body: When you submit an enquiry, project brief or callback request, we collect the details you provide: your name, email address, phone number, company and a description of your project.
Our server logs record technical request data such as IP address, browser and timestamps. IP addresses are hashed with a server-side pepper before storage and are used only for abuse prevention.
If Google Analytics is enabled, it collects standard usage metrics. You can block analytics scripts with any standard browser setting or extension.

sections.title: How we use information
body: Enquiry and callback information is used solely to respond to your request and to discuss potential work. We do not sell, rent or trade personal information to third parties.
Aggregated, non-identifying statistics may be used to improve the website.

sections.title: Retention
body: Enquiry records are retained only as long as needed to serve the enquiry and meet legal or business record requirements. You may request deletion of your enquiry records at any time by emailing us.

sections.title: Cookies
body: This site uses only functional cookies. Editors and administrators receive a strictly necessary session cookie for authentication. No advertising or cross-site tracking cookies are set by us.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of personal information we hold about you by writing to hello@savotechnologies.com. We respond to verified requests within a reasonable period.

sections.title: Security
body: Information is transmitted over HTTPS and stored with access controls. No internet transmission is perfectly secure, but we apply the same engineering standards to this website that we apply to client systems.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: If this policy changes, the revised version will be published on this page. Continued use of the site after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.title: Contact
body: Savo Technologies Private Limited, Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India. Email: hello@savotechnologies.com. Phone: +91 75029 01234.

terms.heading: Terms and Conditions.
terms.lead: The short, honest version: this site is informational, and real projects run on signed agreements.

sections.title: Acceptance
body: By using this website you agree to these terms. The site is operated by Savo Technologies Private Limited, Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India.

sections.title: Purpose of this website
body: This website presents information about Savo Technologies and provides enquiry and contact forms. It is informational; nothing on it constitutes a binding offer, a quote or professional advice.
Any engagement, project or service relationship is formed only through a separate written agreement signed by both parties.

sections.title: Acceptable use
body: You agree not to misuse this website: no automated scraping that degrades the service, no submitting false or abusive enquiries, and no attempts to access non-public areas without authorization.

sections.title: Intellectual property

sections.title: No warranties
body: The website is provided as is. We work to keep information accurate and current, but content may change and we do not warrant uninterrupted availability.

sections.title: Limitation of liability
body: To the extent permitted by law, Savo Technologies is not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from use of this website.

Any dispute, claim, or legal proceeding arising out of or relating to these Terms, the use of this website, or the services provided by Savo Technologies Private Limited shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts located in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India.
